audit.whatIsWrong: Miasma grounding his hop is stated, but the reverse — that GNAR! is how a dash-less Cassiopeia gets killed — is never connected to terrain or to Flash.
audit.why: Riot's GNAR! text: 'Any enemy that hits a wall is stunned and takes bonus damage.' You have no dash in the kit, so a wall behind you converts his ult from a knockback into a full stun. Miasma's grounding does cover his Hop, since Riot's text says grounded enemies cannot use Movement abilities and Hop is a leap.
audit.corrected: The wall-stun rule and the hold-Flash-for-the-wall instruction written into the late spike, the late text, the key-interactions slot and the loading tip.

edits.before: This is your window. Watch his Rage bar: when he's about to Mega, save Miasma and Petrifying Gaze for the GNAR! brick stun. edits.before: The lane flips back late. Mega-Gnar front-lines as a tanky bruiser who kites your short range with boomerang and brick autos, and a single landed GNAR! AoE stun deletes you since you build glass, stack no resistances, and can't even buy boots to reposition. You out-DPS him in a clean grounded 1v1 if you can land Miasma and chain Twin Fang, but you rarely get it uninterrupted in a fight — respect his Rage timer, never get caught alone for the Mega stun, and pump damage from the back while your front-line eats his engage.
